definitions.explanation: A person who has not yet reached the age of legal adulthood. In Japan, the age of majority was lowered from 20 to 18 in April 2022.

examples.japanese: {未成年|みせいねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{未成年|みせいねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Smoking by minors is prohibited by law.

examples.japanese: {未成年|みせいねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: When a minor enters a contract, parental consent is required.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a standalone noun and as a modifier: {未成年|みせいねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧ (underage person). Japan lowered the age of majority from 20 to 18 in April 2022, but the minimum age for drinking and smoking remains 20.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未成年|みせいねん}{者|しゃ}: minor (formal)
- {未成年|みせいねん}⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧: underage drinking
- {未成年|みせいねん}⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧: underage smoking
- {未成年|みせいねん}⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧: juvenile crime

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧: adult (antonym)
- ⟦{成年|せいねん}→成年：00456_seinen⟧: adulthood, age of majority (antonym)
